description: Save a conduitAI catalog asset (MCP server, agent, skill, prompt, plugin, MCP client) to your bookmarks for later. Idempotent: bookmarking an already-bookmarked asset is a no-op. Capacity is capped at 1000 per user.

asset_type.description: The type of asset to bookmark

item_id.description: Asset UUID. Either slug or item_id is required.

slug.description: Asset slug (preferred). Either slug or item_id is required.

name: bookmark_asset
title: Bookmark a catalog asset
